workload_interpretation: The outcome-blind near-cap rule selected the same n=1/B0 parameters as the frozen natural workload. Both labels remain in the required matrix, but no regime-separation claim may be made from the labels alone.

action_roles.light_rule: lowest median V2 fit-cell Q0.99 latency across the frozen calibration grid

policy_logic.Greedy-Risk: Without a shield, maximize p_risk*validation_TPR - (1-p_risk)*validation_FPR; ties use action_order.
policy_logic.Safe-Greedy: Using the exact V2 guard shared with FSSQL-R, maximize the frozen immediate total reward over A_safe; use the frozen least-violating fallback if empty.
policy_logic.Threshold: Apply the frozen conventional threshold hysteresis without A_safe.
policy_logic.Unshielded-Q: Greedy argmax from the mapped frozen Unshielded-Q table over all actions; epsilon=0 and no update.
policy_logic.FSSQL-R: Greedy argmax from the mapped frozen FSSQL-R table over the exact same V2 A_safe used by Safe-Greedy; epsilon=0 and no update; frozen fallback if empty.

threshold_controller.derivation: T_hi=82-epsilon_T; T_lo=T_hi-2; TinyDL conservative B0 latency is <=40 ms through n256 and >40 ms at n512; p_hi uses the preregistered validation-only default.

execution_order.rule: Within each matched seed block, apply numpy.random.default_rng(base_seed + evaluation_seed).permutation to all 16 regime/policy combinations; execute seed blocks in ascending seed order.

start_and_cooldown.cooling: heatsink, continuously running fan, case top open
start_and_cooldown.power: corrected/replaced adapter and cable on stable wall-outlet path

invalid_if: any current undervoltage or throttle low-nibble bit
any per-window CPU frequency below 1350 MHz
missing, non-finite, or incomplete required log fields
unrelated background job or unexpected process/I/O failure
invalid_attempt_rule: Retain the entire partial attempt and lineage. Stop the campaign; never stitch runs and never retry silently.

official_test.opening_rule: Open only after near-cap freeze, policy preregistration, Q-learning configuration, frozen Q tables, hashes, Git-clean check, and device preflight all pass.
official_test.post_open_rule: No model, guard, workload, threshold, reward, state-bin, Q-learning, or policy change based on official-test outcomes.
